run_main: run the main function to load a mesh, compute its SDF, and visualize it with SDFViewer
load_gt_mesh: load a ground truth mesh from a URDF file path using load_gt_mesh
sdf_from_mesh: compute a signed distance field from a mesh using sdf_util.sdf_from_mesh with voxel size and extend factor
SDFViewer: visualize a mesh and its SDF grid using SDFViewer with colormap and surface cutoff parameters
review_main: review the main function that demonstrates the full mesh to SDF pipeline from loading to visualization
